_comment: Copy to config.local.json and fill in. config.local.json is gitignored - see docs/constraints.md C4. This example is validated against spec/app-config.schema.json.

upstream._comment: The ONLY hosts this tool will forward to. A request for anything else is refused locally and never dialled. docs/constraints.md C1.

auto._comment: Keyed by SHORT game id (the part after '-g-'). Value is an account uuid, or '' to disable. After phase 0 confirms the real id, delete the guess and keep only the confirmed one.

log_key._comment: Per-game HMAC keys, keyed by short game id. MUST stay empty here - real keys go in config.local.json. docs/constraints.md C4. Phase 0 makes this obtainable; until then the tool cannot sign anything and will raise MissingLogKeyError.

device._comment: Copied verbatim from the reference implementation so the SDK sees an already-known device. Changing this adds a variable while the project is still unproven.

confirm._comment: clear_flag_on_success must stay true - it is the fix for the reference implementation's state-leak defect. 开发侧架构拆解 defect 2.

network._comment: emulator_proxy keeps host DNS untouched. host_nrpt is what the reference implementation does and should be a last resort.
